title: Nazi Rise and Consolidation
welcome_lead: Today you'll trace how Hitler rose to power and locked it in by 1934.
meta_desc: GCSE History Nazi rise — Depression, Hitler as Chancellor, Reichstag Fire, Enabling Act.
final_note: You can now explain step by step how Hitler took and consolidated power.

concepts.def: World economic slump from 1929 — millions jobless
The Nazi Party led by Adolf Hitler
Germany's head of government — Hitler from 1933
27 Feb 1933 fire used to crush opposition
March 1933 law letting Hitler rule by decree

walkthroughs.body_html:
After the 1929 Wall Street Crash, US loans to Germany dried up.

Unemployment soared to over 6 million. Voters turned to extreme parties. By July 1932 the NSDAP was the largest party in the Reichstag.

On 30 January 1933 President Hindenburg made Hitler Chancellor.

The Reichstag Fire in February let Hitler blame communists and arrest opponents. The Enabling Act in March let him pass laws without parliament.

In June 1934 the Night of the Long Knives purged the SA leadership and other rivals.

When Hindenburg died in August 1934, Hitler merged President and Chancellor as Fuhrer. The army swore loyalty to him personally.
